news.headline: Six Rare Baby Birds Hatch at Zoo Atlanta
news.body: Zoo Atlanta says six Bali myna chicks hatched there this year! Bali mynas are snowy-white birds with black tips on their wings and tails and bright blue skin around their eyes. Back in 2001, only six of them were left in the wild. Thanks to people working hard to protect them, there are now about 600. Every new chick helps them keep coming back.

news.headline: A Rubber Band Ball as Heavy as an Elephant!
news.body: A man in Detroit named Claude Moore spent 11 years wrapping rubber bands around and around into one giant ball. Now it's the biggest rubber band ball in the world! It weighs 11,578 pounds, about as much as an elephant. It was so heavy that a crane had to lift it to weigh it, and the crowd cheered when it beat the old record.

news.headline: Astronauts Get Ready to Add the Last Big Solar Panel
news.body: Astronauts on the International Space Station are getting ready for a spacewalk on Thursday. They plan to unroll the eighth and final new solar panel, like rolling out a giant mat. It finishes a job that started in 2021 to give the station more power from sunlight. The spacewalk should take about seven hours, and people can watch it live.

fun_fact: Natural rubber starts as a milky white sap called latex that drips out of rubber trees, kind of like maple syrup comes from maple trees! 🌳

joke.q: Why do birds fly south for the winter?
joke.a: Because it's too far to walk! 🐦

word_of_the_day.meaning: to copy the way something sounds or acts
word_of_the_day.sentence: Bali myna birds can mimic sounds, and some can even copy words.

this_day_in_history: On November 4, 1922, Howard Carter's team found the first step down to King Tut's tomb in Egypt. Inside were thousands of treasures, including a golden mask! 🏺
did_you_know: Starlings are amazing copycats. Some can copy car alarms, phone rings, and the songs of other birds! 🎶
